    static void
    reconfigure(ch.qos.logback.classic.LoggerContext context, ClassLoader resources)
    Resets the Logger Context and configures it from the application's resources, for development mode, whose launcher keeps Logback in a parent tier that does not see them: the Configurator services of the resources' loader, the logback.configurationFile JVM system property, logback-test.xml or logback.xml among the resources, the logback.xml file of the working directory, then the basic console configuration.

  • Method Details

    • reconfigure

      @Internal public static void reconfigure(ch.qos.logback.classic.LoggerContext context, ClassLoader resources)
      Resets the Logger Context and configures it from the application's resources, for development mode, whose launcher keeps Logback in a parent tier that does not see them: the Configurator services of the resources' loader, the logback.configurationFile JVM system property, logback-test.xml or logback.xml among the resources, the logback.xml file of the working directory, then the basic console configuration. Errors are reported as Logback's startup reports them: printed, and not thrown.
      Parameters:
      context - The Logger Context
      resources - The loader of the application's resources
      Since:
      5.3.0

    • describeConfiguration

      @Internal public static @Nullable String describeConfiguration(ClassLoader resources)
      What reconfigure(LoggerContext, ClassLoader) would configure a Logger Context with, for development mode to tell whether it changed: the Configurator services, or the configuration file.
      Parameters:
      resources - The loader of the application's resources, or the one that loaded Logback
      Returns:
      "Configurator services" when a Configurator service configures Logback, the URL of the configuration file otherwise, or null when there is neither and Logback falls back to its basic configuration
      Since:
      5.3.0

    • configure

      @Deprecated(since="5.3", forRemoval=true) public static void configure(ClassLoader classLoader, ch.qos.logback.classic.LoggerContext context, String logbackXmlLocation)
      Deprecated, for removal: This API element is subject to removal in a future version.
      This method cannot tell a location set in configuration from a default one, and it uses the first Configurator service whatever its rank and status. Call LoggingSystem.refresh() on the logging system bean instead.
      Configures a Logger Context.
      Parameters:
      classLoader - Class Loader
      context - Logger Context
      logbackXmlLocation - the location of the xml logback config file
